A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
p55CDC is a regulator of G1/S transition in myeloid progenitor cells and may have a role in the pathogenesis of acute myeloid leukemia.
p55Ccd/Cdc20 may have dual function in the cell cycle, as a regulator of the spindle assembly checkpoint in mitosis and also in early G1 to S cell cycle transition in the myeloid cells.

p55Cde/Cdc20 is involved in G1‐to‐S phase transition in myeloid cell lines.
